note: Fresh long/complex statements. Conditional and negative meaning must be inspected beyond directed endpoints.

cases.text: A blue vase rests on a shelf above a red suitcase. A cat sits beside the suitcase while a butterfly flies above the vase.
A sensor detects smoke and sends a signal to a controller. The controller opens a door only when smoke is detected.
A dog sits beside a cat. The dog does not chase the cat, and a bird flies above both animals.
Water flows from a mountain through a river into a lake. A bridge crosses the river, and a cyclist stands beside the bridge holding a yellow umbrella.
